author: R. Alvarez
title: Partial beam loss during the lifetime study (top-up off)
text: Lifetime study on the owl shift with top-up off and manual refills every three quarters of an hour. Around 00:30 the stored current dropped suddenly and stayed low until the next refill. Cause traced to a short RF trip on cavity 2; the interlock cleared on its own and the refill went in normally. The DCCT trace for the shift is attached. No further losses for the rest of the study.

author: M. Chen
title: Beam dump on vacuum interlock, sector 4
text: Lost all stored beam at 13:52 when the sector 4 ion gauge tripped the vacuum interlock. Pressure recovered within ten minutes; refilled from zero and operations resumed at 14:40. Nothing to compare with a partial loss: the current went straight to zero.

author: T. Nakamura
title: Injection efficiency check after the lifetime study
text: Measured injection efficiency over twenty shots this morning: 71 percent average, 64 percent worst shot, within the usual band. No retuning needed.
